text: The search speed is terribly slow. Every time I type a query it freezes for 5-10 seconds before returning results.
We really need an export option to CSV and PDF so we can share summaries with executive leadership.
Your pricing is way too expensive for early-stage startups and small teams. Competitor X is half the price.
Onboarding is confusing. I didn't know where to start or how to invite my engineering teammates.
The dashboard layout is cluttered and difficult to navigate. The sidebar hides critical settings.
Please add a direct integration with Slack and Jira so our team gets pinged on critical alerts.
The mobile web view is completely broken. Buttons overlap and tables are unreadable on phones.
Love the core concept and AI synthesis! It saves our PM team hours every week during sprint discovery.
Search indexing crashes whenever we upload a dataset with more than 1000 items. Need bulk optimization.
Customer support chats are difficult to track. Wish you had a live status dashboard for pending tickets.
